title: Low-Field J-Coupling Spectroscopy Measured with a Diamond Nitrogen Vacancy Spectrometer
summary: Nitrogen vacancy centers in diamond (NVs) are point defects well suited to quantum sensing of magnetic fields. NV spin states can be initialized and read out optically with high spatial resolution, enabling detection of pL-scale volumes of nuclear spins. Using Coherently Averaged Synchronized Readout (CASR), standard NMR spectroscopy techniques such as free decay, spin echo, and PGSE have been performed with Hz-scale spectral resolution using NV-diamond sensors.
